title: Pitched roofs on living-salon, sunset-lounge, east-suite-1, west-suite-1
relationship: A pitched roof carries a 0.1 m fascia on all four edges and cannot be trimmed to its exposed edges (gable; hip; hip; hip). It is valid only where every neighbour at that level is lower than the fascia or absent.
softwareRole: Derives, from adjacency alone, which neighbours each pitched roof meets and along which edges; builds the exposed remainder of a partly covered flat roof itself.
modelDecides: Which rooms get a pitched or overhanging roof (a design choice), and the roof strategy for abutting rooms (flat, lower neighbour, or separated by a gap).

title: east wall of east-suite-2 (shared with east-bath-2)
relationship: 2 opening(s) and 1 screen(s) are authored on a wall whose neighbour decides what can stand there.
softwareRole: Derives the wall and position of any door or opening declared with host side "shared", and of a window declared "exposed" when exactly one exposed run exists; reports the exposed runs of every edge.
modelDecides: What this wall is: an interior connection, an exterior window (needs an exposed run) or nothing. A room wrapped on every edge has no exterior window or screen.
